description: The Flight Information Exchange Model (FIXM) is a global exchange standard for flight and flow information, provided as a set of XML schemas that support the data exchange needed for ICAO's Flight and Flow Information for a Collaborative Environment (FF-ICE) concept. It has three layers: FIXM Core, the globally applicable basic flight data endorsed by the FIXM change control board; FIXM Applications, which add message metadata and guidance such as XML templates, for example the FF-ICE message package; and FIXM Extensions for regional needs. Coverage: global air traffic management. Recent releases listed on the site include FIXM Core v4.3.0 with Basic Message v1.1.0, a maintenance release of FF-ICE Message v1.1.0 in April 2024 and the FIXM US Extension v4.4.0 in September 2025. Format and access: XML schema packages and a user manual downloadable from fixm.aero, and a work area hosted by EUROCONTROL that is open to the public after free registration; free. Licence: not read. Caveats: FIXM defines message structures, not flight data. Simulation uses: a common structure for flight plan and flow data in air traffic simulations and digital twins of airspace capacity and disruption. Related records: EUROCONTROL's NEST (model-network-strategic-tool-nest) is an airspace capacity tool that uses flight data.
